specs.note: Superseded by a different design: the new engine never publishes a staged directory, it applies the pack inside an already registered instance and makes each individual file atomic (`<dest>.part` → SHA-512 check → bounded-retry rename), so there is no `renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE)` step and no directory that can appear twice.
specs.gap: The whole-directory no-replace publication (Windows `os.rename`, Linux `renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE)`) has no equivalent by design; per-file atomicity is the replacement, and it is weaker at exactly one point — a half-applied instance is a reachable state, handled by the journal-driven resume (F-076) instead of by refusing the publish.

evidence: src/app/pages/InstanceExport.tsx::InstanceExport (preview -> plan review -> Write, every edit invalidates the plan)
specs.note: Export is plan-then-write over IPC: `plan_modpack_export` resolves the lock through the provider and walks the chosen folders without writing, the review lists files, overrides, skipped projects and excluded paths with a translated reason per line, and `write_modpack_export` re-plans against the disk and refuses if the lock digest moved since the preview (`expectedLockSha512`), then writes a sibling temp zip and renames it over the target — a TOCTOU guard, an atomic publication and a `spawn_blocking` write that the old worker-thread exporter did not have; the carrier format is `.mrpack` (a documented decision in docs/spec/behaviors/import-export.md §8) rather than the old custom profile zip, and `saves`, `mods`, logs and the app's own staging trees are never offered as overrides.
